code_indexing.guarantee: The pinned upstream README documents --code-only as local AST extraction with no LLM or API key. Prism does not invoke this command.

upstream.notice: The pinned upstream NOTICE identifies Graphify as Apache License 2.0 and notes prior MIT-licensed contributions. Prism redistributes no Graphify executable, Python package, or generated graph.

contract.source: Graphify-Labs/graphify graphify/serve.py list_tools at tag v0.9.61; project_path is injected into every upstream tool schema.

platform_support.reason: The pinned upstream pyproject requires Python >=3.10 but does not provide Prism a platform compatibility contract. Operators validate their own platform.

dependency_hashes.release_asset: Recorded above from the upstream release.
dependency_hashes.python_distribution: No Python wheel or source-distribution hashes are embedded because Prism does not download, install, or manage Python dependencies.

deliberately_unsupported: Prism does not create or own a Python environment.
Prism does not download or install Graphify or its MCP extra.
Prism does not automatically build, refresh, or infer a repository index.
Prism does not certify a platform beyond recording the upstream Python requirement.
